## Activity

During July 2026, North City Eye Clinic completed 492 captures. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists managed across the reporting period. The clinic reported no disruption to the scheduled work apart from routine leave. Capture activity was recorded and submitted for the usual grading process.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 12 ungradable captures, representing 2.4% of all captures completed during July 2026. These images could not be used for a grading decision and should be considered in routine quality monitoring. The result provides a basis for reviewing image acquisition and reinforcing capture guidance where required.

## Grading

Grading identified 141 referable results. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading was completed within the expected operational workflow during the month. Results requiring referral should continue to be managed through the established clinical pathway, with local teams maintaining oversight of outstanding actions. Overall, the available activity, image quality and grading measures provide a summary of the clinic’s performance for July 2026.
